clips.name: Star Noise Floor
clips.why: The 2.725 K hiss as sparse grey dots on sensor-bias black, drifting glacially; in Dark Run this is all there is.

clips.name: Paper Ruling
clips.why: Faint chart-paper ruling; hi-hats only soften the lines into hiss, nothing else moves.

clips.name: Faint First Dot
clips.why: Bible says Blank; a near-invisible grey dot foreshadows the pale blue dot of Deep Field.

clips.name: Blank
clips.why: Bible says Blank; the pen lamp is not yet lit and nothing lifts the sensor-bias black.

clips.name: Freq Readout
clips.why: The hydrogen line frequency as bottom-left teletype telemetry in margin grey.

clips.name: Blank
clips.why: Bible says Blank; no colour in the hut yet and nothing added to the frame.

clips.name: Paper Tooth
clips.why: The chart paper's tooth at six percent.

clips.name: Chart Pen Scope
clips.why: The honest readout: one chart-pen line at the bottom edge, in margin grey while the run is dark.

clips.name: Star Noise Drift
clips.why: Same star-noise floor, a touch denser; low-mids breathe the dot density on a slow envelope.

clips.name: Paper Ruling Push
clips.why: The ruling thickens on every kick, a quarter-inch of scruff on the paper.

clips.name: Beam Pattern
clips.why: Three thin deep-field-blue rings as the dish beam pattern, breathed slowly outward by the lows instead of a timeline.

clips.name: Dish Beacon
clips.why: The amber dish beacon, one soft flash every couple of bars, transparent in the off phase.

clips.name: Scruff Note
clips.why: The margin annotation of the first hint, bottom-left and never centred.

clips.name: Blank
clips.why: Bible says Blank; still no colour in the hut.

clips.name: Paper Tooth
clips.why: Chart paper tooth, unchanged.

clips.name: Chart Pen Scope
clips.why: Same scope, now in chart paper as the pen starts to draw.

clips.name: Buff Noise Floor
clips.why: The same floor tinted toward buff paper so the desk under the pen lamp feels warm.

clips.name: Pen Trace
clips.why: The chart recorder pen scrolling across the paper; a kick pushes the pen and the ink lingers.

clips.name: Pen Lamp Disc
clips.why: One small amber disc, the pen lamp, with a trace of grain noise standing in for the slow wobble.

clips.name: Lamp Pool
clips.why: A warm radial pool of lamp light fading to nothing at the edges, the one warm thing in the hut.

clips.name: Paper Log
clips.why: One line of clerical wonder in the margin on the same baseline as the other columns; CHART SPEED 1 IN/MIN is held for a text-swap or a second deck.

clips.name: Blank
clips.why: Bible says Blank; the lamp pool on LIGHT does the warming, this cell adds nothing.

clips.name: Graph Paper
clips.why: Forty-eight hairline vertical time-divisions under the horizontally scrolling pen, the chart ruling as ruling and not a screen.

clips.name: Chart Pen Scope
clips.why: The honest pen at the bottom edge, chart paper.

clips.name: Star Noise Breath
clips.why: Star-noise floor breathing on low-mids under the pulsar stack.

clips.name: CP1919 Ridgeline
clips.why: The stacked pulsar plot in chart paper, the deck's spine; each kick pushes the ridge up and the paper is allowed a little glow.

clips.name: Beam Arcs
clips.why: The beam pattern opened into alternating arcs, a radar sweep frozen; lows thicken the stroke.

clips.name: Pulsar Flash
clips.why: A hard chart-paper flash tuned near the 1.337 second period, held from the pad under the ridgeline.

clips.name: Pulsar Log
clips.why: The pulsar's designation as margin telemetry on the shared baseline; PERIOD 1.3373 S and LGM-1 are the best candidates for a pad text-swap.

clips.name: Blank
clips.why: Bible says Blank; the pulse is too regular to be natural and the room stays grey.

clips.name: Paper Tooth
clips.why: Paper tooth a touch stronger under the flashes.

clips.name: Chart Pen Scope
clips.why: The honest pen, chart paper.

clips.name: Star Noise Swell
clips.why: The floor swells on the lows as the signal arrives, a tide rather than a flash.

clips.name: Wow Ridge Stack
clips.why: The ridgeline taller and more jagged, the intensity column 6EQUJ5 climbing off the chart.

clips.name: Beam Afterimage
clips.why: The beam pattern breathing about 20% outward on the lows, slow release, leaving thin blue afterimages instead of a zoom flash.

clips.name: 72 Second Rise
clips.why: A still radial chart-paper wash, bright centre fading to nothing; the performer rides the layer-4 fader up and back over the 72 seconds (or a clip-opacity timeline if the builder supports one) so the rise and fall happens once, not on a strobe cycle.

clips.name: Wow Typewriter
clips.why: The deck's only red and only centred text, typed on character by character from an invisible start state (Opacity 0, Scale 0.85) so each glyph settles in, retriggered from the pad.

clips.name: H-Alpha Wash
clips.why: 656 nm hydrogen-alpha as an edge-only radial wash with a clear centre, at ten percent so it lands near the bible's 8% whisper; the one place the reserved red exists.

clips.name: Printout Lines
clips.why: Dense printout lines as the Big Ear teletype texture; highs blur them into hiss.

clips.name: Chart Pen Scope
clips.why: The honest pen stays chart paper even under the red.

clips.name: Developing Plate
clips.why: The same dot field at four times the density, a plate of three thousand galaxies that the performer's Trails knob will develop.

clips.name: Knotted Horizon
clips.why: The spine flattens toward a horizon and the knots show, point sources on the plot.

clips.name: Galaxy Cores
clips.why: A few soft deep-field-blue cores drifting slowly and accumulating like an eleven-day exposure.

clips.name: One Pixel Dot
clips.why: The pale blue dot in chart paper at Scale 0.01, under a pixel wide at 1080p, on the LIGHT row: for the Exposure to dot moment pull faders 1, 2 and 3 to zero and tap the row-4 LIGHT pad so only this is lit.

clips.name: Dot Caption
clips.why: The margin note that makes the whole room look at one pixel.

clips.name: Deep Field Blue
clips.why: A vertical deep-field-blue grade, the first colour allowed in the hut since the red left.

clips.name: Moth Dust
clips.why: Fine grey dust that only the hi-hats stir.

clips.name: Chart Pen Scope
clips.why: The honest pen, chart paper.

clips.name: Dead Air Static
clips.why: The carrier is gone and the whole picture is hiss, tinted down and held to a couple of frames a second by Stop Motion so the static steps instead of boils; the one static field in the column.

clips.name: Flatline
clips.why: Bible says Blank; a dead flat pen line across the centre that never reacts, against the live scope below.

clips.name: Blank
clips.why: Bible says Blank; the beam pattern is gone and nothing ghosts it.

clips.name: Blank
clips.why: Bible says Blank; the lamp is off.

clips.name: No Carrier Line
clips.why: The modem's last words in the margin, read and not shaken.

clips.name: Blank
clips.why: Bible says Blank; no colour, the hiss is the room.

clips.name: Paper Tooth
clips.why: Chart paper tooth at six percent, unchanged; the stepped hiss lives on L1 now.

clips.name: Chart Pen Scope
clips.why: The honest pen stays chart paper so the readout survives the hiss; still follows the music 1:1 with the carrier lost.

clips.name: Pre-Dawn Sky
clips.why: Night at the top, pre-dawn blue-grey at the horizon; highs add a breath of dither grain to the sky.

clips.name: Dish Mesh Hex
clips.why: Eight hexagon outlines held to the outer band, the dish rim seen at first light; the centre is left empty for the VLF spiral. Mids lift the glow.

clips.name: VLF Curl
clips.why: A single minimal blue spiral, the dawn chorus spectrogram curl, turning a little faster when the mids rise.

clips.name: Blank
clips.why: Bible says Blank; the dawn is in the sky grade and the spiral, not a rim.

clips.name: Last Annotation
clips.why: The closing line, the only column where the text is chart paper.

clips.name: Pre-Dawn Wash
clips.why: A radial pre-dawn blue-grey grade, the first sky of the night.

clips.name: Paper Tooth
clips.why: Chart paper tooth, the clean deck to the end.

clips.name: Chart Pen Scope
clips.why: The honest pen, chart paper, drawing the dawn.

clips.name: Console Grid
clips.why: The room's 16x9 grid at 4% contrast on dead-air black, the console floor that never moves.

clips.name: Voice Loop Trace
clips.why: Twelve thin horizontal loop-trace lines in P39 green whose softness breathes slowly with the low-mids.

clips.name: Limb Far West
clips.why: The lunar limb as a thin teletype circle pushed to the left edge, first step of its crossing over the scene set.

clips.name: Tally Lamp
clips.why: One small amber square in the top-right corner flashing slowly, the tally lamp on the bar.

clips.name: Go For TLI
clips.why: The capcom call left-justified like a transcript line in phosphor green, kept off the limb and the scope.

clips.name: Room Dark Edge
clips.why: Explicit Blank in the bible, so a nearly invisible radial darkening fills the cell without changing the room.

clips.name: Hiss 2.2k
clips.why: Grayscale noise at 10% stepped by Stop Motion so the carrier hiss ticks instead of boils.

clips.name: Downlink Scope
clips.why: The honest readout: one phosphor-green trace full width along the lower third, the downlink carrier following the signal.

clips.name: Console Grid Live
clips.why: Same room grid a hair brighter because the loop is busy and every console is lit.

clips.name: Carrier Wave
clips.why: Three mirrored carrier lines whose modulation deepens with the low-mids, the voice loop as a living waveform.

clips.name: Limb West
clips.why: The limb one step further into the room, outline thickening faintly on the kick.

clips.name: Tally Lamp
clips.why: The same tally lamp keeps the bar across the first three scenes.

clips.name: Capcom Flight
clips.why: The loop's call sign in the transcript position, same green, same size, so the room stays one room.

clips.name: Console Dusk
clips.why: Bible Blank: console grey at 5% in Overlay is a cell filled with nothing you can see.

clips.name: Hiss 2.2k
clips.why: Carrier hiss stays constant while the loop talks.

clips.name: Downlink Scope
clips.why: Identical scope, the picture of a radio room.

clips.name: Console Grid
clips.why: Back to the 4% grid; the room holds its breath for the count.

clips.name: Trace Tightening
clips.why: The loop trace drawn thinner and pushed by the kick, tension under the countdown.

clips.name: Limb Near Centre
clips.why: The Moon almost in front of the room as the spacecraft goes behind it.

clips.name: Tally Counting
clips.why: The tally lamp a touch faster, counting with the capcom.

clips.name: Countdown Ten
clips.why: The rig's own countdown idea rebuilt stock: characters fade in front to back one per second when the row-5 pad retriggers it.

clips.name: Room Dark Edge
clips.why: Bible Blank, filled with a near-invisible vignette so the grid has no hole.

clips.name: Hiss 2.2k
clips.why: Stepped hiss, unchanged, the last normal thing before LOS.

clips.name: Downlink Scope
clips.why: Identical scope; it is about to become the only thing moving.

clips.name: Dead Air Black
clips.why: Dead Air is Solid Color bed and nothing else: the grid goes away with the carrier.

clips.name: Flat ECG
clips.why: A flat green line scrolling fast above the heart, deliberately unbound so it stays flat while the Metaball swells; hand-fired from the row-2 pad.

clips.name: The Heart
clips.why: One soft teletype Metaball low in the frame that swells on the sub band, the heart of the room in dead air.

clips.name: Heartbeat Lamp
clips.why: The Heartbeat preset done by hand: a full-frame amber pulse with Fade on at a quarter opacity so the OFF phase is clear, not black.

clips.name: Dead Air Count
clips.why: The loop keeps counting into silence; the line is there for the pad, not the scene launch.

clips.name: Nothing On Loop
clips.why: Explicit Blank before the violet arrives; an almost nothing cell.

clips.name: No Hiss
clips.why: Explicit Blank: the hiss stops with the carrier, so this is bed black at 4% in Overlay, invisible.

clips.name: Downlink Scope
clips.why: Dead Air lands with only BED and SCOPE; this is the one thing still moving.

clips.name: Grid Blue Cast
clips.why: The room grid returns with a faint blue-violet cast in the grey, something off about the light.

clips.name: Far Side Corridor
clips.why: Wormhole-style thin green tunnel lines that pull inward on the lows and thicken with hiss, the far side as a corridor.

clips.name: Violet Throat
clips.why: A filled, mirrored, heavily modulated violet waveform smeared by Trails: the whistling given a body that does not belong in Houston.

clips.name: Tally Wrong
clips.why: The tally lamp flutters off the bar with Fade on, answering a transmission nobody sent.

clips.name: Whistling Sound
clips.why: The only column where the transcript goes violet, because something else is on the loop.

clips.name: Far Side Violet
clips.why: The reserved aura colour finally used, 12% violet wash over the whole room.

clips.name: Hiss Thickening
clips.why: The hiss comes back a little louder than it left.

clips.name: Downlink Scope
clips.why: The scope stays honest green even while the text turns violet.

clips.name: Grid Lit
clips.why: Console grey at full 4% contrast; every light in the room is on for the alarm.

clips.name: Alarm Trace
clips.why: The loop trace doubled to 24 lines and torn by Shift Glitch, the 1202 program alarm on the display.

clips.name: Limb Jittering
clips.why: The limb past centre with hatched noise shaking its edge on the mids; the Moon is still there but the picture is not clean.

clips.name: Master Alarm
clips.why: The tally lamp grown into a master-alarm square flashing hard and fast, the peak of the deck.

clips.name: Alarm 1202
clips.why: The alarm code larger than any other line, still the same green, still left-justified.

clips.name: Room Dark Edge
clips.why: Bible Blank: the violet is gone, the room is Houston again.

clips.name: Alarm Static
clips.why: Two-tone noise stepping faster, hiss turned to crackle under the alarm.

clips.name: Downlink Scope
clips.why: Identical scope under the alarm, the only steady readout in the room.

clips.name: Grid Sunrise
clips.why: The grid at console grey, about to be overrun by the white flash.

clips.name: Trace Returning
clips.why: The twelve-line loop trace back on the display with Bloom, the carrier glowing as it reacquires.

clips.name: Limb Sunlit
clips.why: The limb far right in sunrise white with a thicker edge, the spacecraft coming round into the light.

clips.name: AOS Sunrise
clips.why: One long near-white full-frame flash with Fade on at a frequency near zero, acquisition of signal as a sunrise; nothing else in the deck is this bright.

clips.name: Eagle Houston
clips.why: The voice that answers, on the roster after all, in the transcript position.

clips.name: Sunrise Haze
clips.why: Bible Blank, filled with a barely-there warm centre glow that reads as afterimage of the flash.

clips.name: Hiss Fading
clips.why: The hiss thinning as the carrier locks.

clips.name: Downlink Scope
clips.why: Identical scope; the downlink carrier is back and the trace proves it.

clips.name: Newsreel Sky
clips.why: Horizontal gradient from bed black to teletype at 10%, the newsreel's grey sky, with only its dither breathing on the highs.

clips.name: Newsreel Rain
clips.why: Forty thin vertical lines in loop-trace green at 70%, rain on the recovery footage.

clips.name: The Splash
clips.why: Three stroked teletype rings expanding on the lows and persisting through Trails, the capsule hitting the water.

clips.name: Lamp Off
clips.why: Bible Blank: the tally lamp is dark at splashdown, so this is an amber ghost at 5% nobody will see.

clips.name: Splashdown Wire

params.Text:
SPLASHDOWN, 1652 GMT
THE LOOP IS QUIET

clips.why: Two teletype-paper lines in a block, the wire-service close to the transcript.

clips.name: Newsreel Grey
clips.why: Vertical teletype-to-bed wash at 6%, the only aura colour outside Whistling, grey like old film.

clips.name: Newsreel Film
clips.why: Colour static at 14% stepped and pixelated, film grain and weave done the stock way instead of a gate plugin.

clips.name: Downlink Scope
clips.why: The same scope recoloured teletype paper for the newsreel, the only variation it is allowed.

clips.name: Candle Throw
clips.why: One soft candle glow pushed to the north-west over parlour black, breathing on the sub: in Lights Down the flame's throw is the whole room.

clips.name: Vesica Damask
clips.why: Eight thin vesica outlines in daguerreotype sepia, outer only, swelling very slowly on the lows: the wallpaper you never quite see.

clips.name: Muslin Faint
clips.why: Two barely-there ectoplasm blobs, cold grey in a warm room, so the first thing that does not belong is already present at the opening.

clips.name: Lamp Gutter
clips.why: A slow faded candle-colour flicker standing in for the film reel's gutter; hiss makes the lamp stutter a little faster as it is turned down.

clips.name: Lamp Down Please

params.Text:
LAMP DOWN, PLEASE
IS ANYONE THERE

clips.why: The medium's protocol voice in bone Baskerville at the top of frame: the first instruction and the first question.

clips.name: Sepia Vignette
clips.why: Transparent centre, sepia edge: a daguerreotype vignette that closes the room around the candle without touching the flame.

clips.name: Cylinder Hiss
clips.why: Grayscale noise at eight percent is the wax cylinder's surface hiss under everything, the stock stand-in for the React Gate grain.

clips.name: EVP Needle
clips.why: The EVP recorder's needle in moth dust along the bottom edge, the one honest readout that follows the signal 1:1.

clips.name: Lamp Down Radial
clips.why: A still candle-to-parlour-black radial: the lamp is down and the room has settled, so the environment stops moving while hands are joined.

clips.name: Ring Of Sitters
clips.why: Twelve concentric sepia circles turning very slowly: the ring of joined hands around the table, the circle that must not be broken.

clips.name: Muslin Rises
clips.why: The bible's muslin exactly, with Trails so the ectoplasm smears behind itself as it rises once the circle is closed.

clips.name: Flame Core
clips.why: A single bloomed candle-colour ball at the lamp's position whose size follows the bass: the Golden Flicker Reel's core bloom rebuilt from stock.

clips.name: Sitters Join Hands

params.Text:
SITTERS JOIN HANDS
DO NOT BREAK THE RING

clips.why: The second instruction and the rule, at the bottom of frame so the muslin above it is unobstructed.

clips.name: Daguerreotype Wash
clips.why: Flat sepia at thirty percent over the whole frame makes everything look already photographed.

clips.name: Damask Weave
clips.why: A fine bone grid at five percent reads as the weave of the tablecloth; hi-hats tighten the mesh and nothing else.

clips.name: EVP Needle
clips.why: Same recorder needle, same moth dust, same bottom edge: the readout never changes between scenes.

clips.name: Candle Flinch
clips.why: The candle throw with a faster, harder sub envelope so each kick is a push on the light, the room flinching with the knock.

clips.name: Table Top Square
clips.why: Ten nested sepia squares, hard-cornered and still: the table top seen from above, the wood that is about to be knocked on.

clips.name: Knock Ripples
clips.why: Six fine ectoplasm rings that expand on the kick and linger through Trails: the knock heard as ripples in the muslin.

clips.name: The Knock
clips.why: A hard bone flash at a slow rate with a clear OFF phase, the one onset the performer fires by pad, never more than once a bar.

clips.name: Knock Once Yes

params.Text:
KNOCK ONCE FOR YES
Y E S

clips.why: The question above the spaced answer; Spacing X tracks the letters out so Y E S reads as a planchette crossing a board.

clips.name: Knock Vignette
clips.why: A darker sepia vignette with a touch of dither closes the edges harder now that something has answered.

clips.name: Cylinder Hiss Up
clips.why: The cylinder hiss a touch louder than the opening, the recorder leaning in.

clips.name: EVP Needle
clips.why: The needle that will jump when the knock lands, the only element allowed to answer the signal 1:1.

clips.name: Table Candle
clips.why: A grainier still candle radial for the long tilt: the environment does not dance while the table does.

clips.name: Tilted Table
clips.why: Nine thin sepia lines fixed eleven degrees off vertical, the table already tilted at 11:47; low-mids soften their edges like the room breathing.

clips.name: Muslin Thickens
clips.why: More blobs, slightly sharper, swelling on the lows: the ectoplasm has mass now and pushes against the tilt.

clips.name: Table Edge Lit
clips.why: Two candle-colour hairlines on the same eleven-degree tilt as the BODY lines, the table edge catching the flame, thickening on the bass.

clips.name: Table Tilted

params.Text:
TABLE TILTED 11:47
G O O D B Y E

clips.why: The log entry over the spaced farewell, tracked out so G O O D B Y E crosses the board letter by letter.

clips.name: Sepia Smoke
clips.why: Grey field tinted parlour-black to sepia, a slow smoke grade whose density opens on the low-mids: the only AURA that moves, and only with the room's breath.

clips.name: Tilted Weave
clips.why: Eighty dense sepia lines on the same tilt as everything else, a tablecloth weave that has slid with the table.

clips.name: EVP Needle
clips.why: The needle stays level while the table tilts; the recorder is the only thing in the room not on the table.

clips.name: Lamp Bloom
clips.why: The candle throw at its widest and warmest so far, breathing on the sub, because the lamp is what the moths are drawn to.

clips.name: Lamp Shade Facets
clips.why: Nested hexagons folded through a Kaleidoscope: the lamp's glass shade seen through its own facets, the damask refracted.

clips.name: Moths At Lamp
clips.why: Twelve fast bone points pulled toward the lamp corner, each leaving a short dust trail; the pad re-spawns them every bar as the bible asks.

clips.name: Lamp And Glass
clips.why: Two bloomed candle balls at the lamp, the flame and its reflection in the glass, swelling on the bass for the moths to cross.

clips.name: Smell Of Violets
clips.why: One line, top of frame, the sitters noticing the scent while they watch the moths; the figure below stays clear.

clips.name: Lamp Sepia Wash
clips.why: The standard daguerreotype wash, thirty percent, so the moth scene keeps the same photographed brown as the rest of the seance.

clips.name: Moth Dust
clips.why: High-octave dense field at ten percent is the dust off the moths' wings; hi-hats brighten it and nothing else.

clips.name: EVP Needle
clips.why: The needle under the moths, unchanged.

clips.name: Candle At Full
clips.why: The brightest candle radial of the deck for the peak, still and steady so the trumpet and the cathedral read against it.

clips.name: Damask Cathedral
clips.why: Twenty gilded chevrons folded by Mirror Quad into gothic arches, the damask becoming a cathedral on the drop, its bloom opening on the low-mids.

clips.name: Trumpet Lifts
clips.why: Seven nested triangles in ectoplasm and candle, the spirit trumpet's bell, swelling outward on the bass as it lifts off the table.

clips.name: Trumpet Glow
clips.why: A soft three-leaf candle spiral turning behind the trumpet, the lamp's light wheeling as the thing in the air moves; the lows zoom it in.

clips.name: Glass Spells Leave

params.Text:
THE TRUMPET LIFTS
GLASS SPELLS L-E-A-V-E

clips.why: The peak's two events logged at the bottom of frame, the order to leave spelled out under the lifting trumpet.

clips.name: Candle Sweep
clips.why: An angular sweep from faint candle to transparent sepia, a gilded wash that lifts the peak a shade above the other candle columns.

clips.name: Hiss Rising
clips.why: Cylinder hiss held at ten percent under the peak so the texture bridges into Class A.

clips.name: EVP Needle
clips.why: The needle at the peak, still honest, still moth dust.

clips.name: Cold Spot NW
clips.why: The candle is gone; one darkened cold-spot blue glow in the north-west corner over parlour black, breathing slowly on the sub, the thing that answered.

clips.name: Cylinder Wave
clips.why: Three fuzzy bone sine lines, the wax cylinder's waveform played back, its amplitude the voice's level on the lows.

clips.name: No Body
clips.why: The voice has no body: a near-invisible ectoplasm fill fills the cell so the grid has no hole.

clips.name: No Lamp
clips.why: No lamp in Class A: a three-percent cold fill holds the cell without adding light.

clips.name: Cold She Says
clips.why: The 1971 overdub typed character by character in cold-spot blue, up in the north-west corner where the cold is; the only column in typewriter.

clips.name: Cold Wash
clips.why: The reserved ice blue used once, at ten percent, so its rarity is the scare.

clips.name: Cylinder Hiss Main
clips.why: Static at eighteen percent is the main texture of Class A: with faders down only the hiss, the needle and the voice remain.

clips.name: EVP Needle
clips.why: The same needle recoloured cold-spot blue for the one column where the recorder is the whole picture.

clips.name: Parlour Black
clips.why: The candle gradient is gone: flat parlour black, the room a minute after the lamp went out.

clips.name: Damask Gone
clips.why: The bible's Blank: a five-percent sepia fill holds the cell with no structure left in the room.

clips.name: Last Of Muslin
clips.why: One tiny soft ectoplasm point up where the lamp was, the last of the muslin, barely breathing before it goes.

clips.name: Lamp Comes Up
clips.why: A slow faded candle pulse with a clear OFF phase: the lamp being turned back up, breath by breath.

clips.name: Break The Circle

params.Text:
BREAK THE CIRCLE NOW
SHE HAS GONE BACK

clips.why: The last instruction dead centre, the one column where nothing stands in the middle of the room to be covered.

clips.name: Cold To Black
clips.why: Cold spot to parlour black at six percent for the last beat, the second and final use of the reserved blue.

clips.name: End Of Groove
clips.why: Two-tone static at twenty percent, harsher than the grayscale hiss: the cylinder at the end of its groove.

clips.name: EVP Needle
clips.why: The needle in bone for the close, the recorder still running after everyone has let go.

clips.name: Crypt Wall Red
clips.why: Crypt black warming to near-black red across the back wall, opaque so the gels have nothing to reflect off but geometry.

clips.name: Circle Sigils
clips.why: Concentric bone circle-sigils tiling the floor, outer ring only, turning once a minute; the kick pushes them outward like a tide.

clips.name: Chalk Circle Drawn
clips.why: One chalk circle nine feet across with a 30-degree opening at the top, still being drawn; the line thickens with the pulse.

clips.name: Lamp From The Left
clips.why: The Lamp of the Art as a hard-stepped red disc pushed to the left edge, lit from the wrong side of the room.

clips.name: Primo Tempo
clips.why: The Rome 1977 intertitle in Bodoni caps tracked wide, chalk, held at the top so it never sits on the circle.

clips.name: Dark Room

clips.name: Wall Struck

clips.name: Hex Sigil Tiles

clips.name: Kamea Of Saturn

clips.name: Hour Blade

HOUR OF SATURN

clips.name: Dark Room Struck

clips.name: Print Roughened

clips.name: Carpenter Pulse

clips.name: Seal Vignette
clips.why: Dark centre, faint red rim: the room closes around the seal.

clips.name: First Seal Grid

clips.name: Lamp Of The Art

clips.name: Kamea Numbers
clips.why: The square that sums to fifteen every way, read as three chalk lines above the seal.

clips.name: Dark Room Seal

clips.name: Register Grid

clips.name: Carpenter Pulse

clips.name: Red Gel Wall

clips.name: Hex Under Red
clips.why: The hexagon sigils turn faster under the red gel and the mids pack more lines into them.

clips.name: Kamea Tilted
clips.why: The verdigris square tilted twelve degrees, the only colour the red gel cannot make, so it looks older than the light.

clips.name: Red Gel Cut
clips.why: A hard stepped cut: half the frame Argento red, half clear, dithered on the edge, the lamp on one side of the room.

clips.name: Non Aprire
clips.why: The Italian intertitle, DO NOT OPEN, Bodoni caps tracked wide, chalk never red.

clips.name: Red Gel Wash

clips.name: Rome Print Red

clips.name: Carpenter Pulse
clips.why: Same bone scope; it stays bone under the red gel.

clips.name: Blue Gel Wall

clips.name: Pentagon Kaleido
clips.why: Pentagon sigils counter-rotating under the second gel, kaleidoscoped to four as the bible's blue-gel moment asks.

clips.name: Kamea Fourfold
clips.why: The Kamea moved into the top-left quadrant and mirrored four ways, the seal multiplied to four and no further.

clips.name: Blue Gel Flash
clips.why: Gel blue pulsing with a fade, roughly one flash per bar, quickening as the mids build.

clips.name: Red Then Blue

params.Text:
LAMP OF THE ART
RED GEL, THEN BLUE

clips.why: The recipe's stage direction in Engravers MT, two chalk lines above the mirrored seal.

clips.name: Blue Gel Wash

clips.name: Rome Print Blue
clips.why: The print grain continues under the blue gel.

clips.name: Carpenter Pulse
clips.why: Same bone scope; it stays bone under the blue gel.

clips.name: Two Gels Meet
clips.why: Near-black red to near-black blue across the wall, the two gels meeting in the middle of the room for the first time.

clips.name: Contracting Web
clips.why: Twenty-four thin bone rings that swell with every kick and bloom toward white, the web pulling at the seal.

clips.name: Seal Turning
clips.why: The verdigris seal set turning and branching, trailing, the one animated figure: the recipe is working.

clips.name: Blue On The Bar
clips.why: Gel blue strobing on the bar while the red moves to AURA, one source per clip.

clips.name: I Conjure Thee
clips.why: The only Text Animator in the deck: the conjuration typed on letter by letter in Perpetua Titling, chalk.

clips.name: Gels Meet
clips.why: Gel red to gel blue at thirty percent, red and blue meeting in the middle of the frame only here.

clips.name: Print Peak Grain
clips.why: The print grain a touch rougher at the peak.

clips.name: Carpenter Pulse
clips.why: Same bone scope at the peak.

clips.name: Last Ember Wall
clips.why: The last near-black red pooled at the centre, crypt black closing in from the edges.

clips.name: Bare Circle
clips.why: One bare bone circle, closed, the web gone; its line breathes with the pulse.

clips.name: Verdigris Point
clips.why: A single verdigris point at the centre that stays when the lamp goes, swelling only slightly with the kick.

clips.name: Lamp Guttering
clips.why: The lamp guttering: a fast faded red flicker masked to a soft off-centre circle at low opacity, the flicker-reel substitute.

clips.name: Non Guardare

params.Text:
THE LAMP IS GOING OUT
NON GUARDARE

clips.why: The warning and its Italian echo, DO NOT LOOK, in chalk above the dying lamp.

clips.name: Red Wash Fading

clips.name: Print Dying
clips.why: Greyscale static as the colour drains from the print.

clips.name: Carpenter Pulse
clips.why: Same scope in a dimmer bone as the lamp goes.

clips.name: Crypt Black
clips.why: Solid crypt black, the gels gone, nothing left on the wall.

clips.name: Empty Circle
clips.why: Explicit blank: the circle is empty, a near-invisible black so the grid has no hole.

clips.name: Nothing Remains
clips.why: Explicit blank: the seal and the point have gone.

clips.name: Lamp Out
clips.why: Explicit blank: the lamp is out.

clips.name: Licence Fine
clips.why: The closing intertitle dead centre because nothing else is in the room: LICENCE TO DEPART with FINE beneath it.

clips.name: Dark Room Fine
clips.why: Explicit blank; no gel over the end card.

clips.name: Print Tail
clips.why: The faintest greyscale grain, the reel running out behind FINE.

clips.name: Carpenter Pulse
clips.why: Same bone scope, dropped to the very bottom edge under FINE.

clips.name: Night Swell
clips.why: The North Sea as a slow wireframe floor; the sub band is a tide, never a flash.

clips.name: Horizon Line
clips.why: One still horizon so the lighthouse sweep is the only motion in the room.

clips.name: Lamp Pulse Ring
clips.why: A single fog ring swelling a hair on the lows, slow release: the lighthouse heard more than seen. Build: drop the FFT and put Size on the four-bar Timeline.

clips.name: Lighthouse Wedge
clips.why: The lamp wedge, SearchLight for blur only. Build: drive Rings Rotation with a 10 s looping Timeline -180 to 180 for Fl(2) W 10s; static -90 in all four wedge columns so the lamp never jumps.

clips.name: At 0048 Long Wave
clips.why: The time and the band, low on the card, under the sea.

clips.name: Horizon Vignette
clips.why: A faint lift at the horizon and long-wave black at the edges closes the room.

clips.name: Long Wave Hiss
clips.why: 198 kHz hiss as grey noise; no film grain in this deck.

clips.name: Bridge Barograph
clips.why: The bridge-radar green readout pinned to the bottom edge, the one honest element; period fixed, hats fuzz the trace, never re-period it.

clips.name: Gale Swell
clips.why: The sea rising and jagged; the kick pushes the swell higher.

clips.name: Stacked Swell
clips.why: Doubled line width, warped and stacking with the lows: the barograph in a gale.

clips.name: Gale Pulse Rings
clips.why: Four pulses leaving ghosts, swelling slowly on the lows, the lighthouse heard more than seen. Build: Size on the four-bar Timeline.

clips.name: Gale Flash
clips.why: The published character as a slow faded lamp flash with a long OFF phase. Rig: verify 0.02 fires slower than once per 5 s, raise only until it does. Build: Frequency on a 10 s Timeline, 0.5 for 1 s then 0 for 9 s, for Fl(2).

params.Text:
SOUTHWEST 5 TO 7
SEVERE GALE 9, LATER
ROUGH OR VERY ROUGH
GOOD OCCASIONALLY POOR

clips.why: The only Text Block: wind, weather, sea, visibility in card white landing on the hit; the gale red lives in the layer 6 wash and nowhere else.

clips.name: Gale Red Wash

clips.name: Gale Hiss

clips.name: Bridge Barograph
clips.why: Same readout, lifted a touch off the bottom edge for the gale; period fixed, hats fuzz the trace.

clips.name: Utsire Swell

clips.name: Barograph Line
clips.why: The swell line and the barograph in one thin grey trace.

clips.name: Utsire Wedge

clips.name: Viking Utsire

clips.name: Utsire Vignette

clips.name: Long Wave Hiss

clips.name: Bridge Barograph
clips.why: The same green readout, unchanged, bottom edge.

clips.name: Drifting Buoys

clips.name: Dogger Flash
clips.why: The light vessel's character, slow and faded, long OFF phase. Rig: verify 0.02 fires slower than once per 5 s. Build: Frequency on a 10 s Timeline, 0.5 for 1 s then 0 for 9 s.

clips.name: Dogger Fisher
clips.why: Second sea area, low on the card so the buoys own the middle.

clips.name: Harbour Lights

clips.name: Dogger Rain
clips.why: Rain later: vertical soft lines swap in for the hiss, never both at once.

clips.name: Bridge Barograph
clips.why: The same green readout, bottom edge.

clips.name: Bight Beam

clips.name: German Bight

clips.name: Bight Harbour

clips.name: Peak Hiss

clips.name: Bridge Barograph
clips.why: The same green readout, bottom edge.

clips.name: Vessel Arcs

clips.name: Fastnet Flash
clips.why: Fastnet's character as a faded lamp flash, long OFF phase. Rig: verify 0.02 fires slower than once per 5 s. Build: Frequency on a 10 s Timeline, 0.5 for 1 s then 0 for 9 s.

clips.why: Sea area low on the card, the litany walking west.

clips.name: Fastnet Harbour
clips.why: Port and starboard lights, the frame still sailing.

clips.why: Steady hiss for the comedown.

clips.name: Bridge Barograph
clips.why: The same green readout, bottom edge.

clips.name: Fog Swell

clips.name: Fog Vignette

clips.name: Rockall Rain

clips.name: Bridge Barograph
clips.why: The same green readout, the only thing admitting there is music.

clips.why: The sea gone flat at dawn; no sub drive, the tide has stopped.

clips.name: Fog Ghost
clips.why: The bible's Blank: a 4% fog lift, nearly invisible, no hole in the grid.
